statement: The system shall respond appropriately to a loan status request.
source_excerpt: Customers want to check their status.

statement: The system approves loans under the auto-approval limit automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded with model version and score.
source_excerpt: If it's under the limit, just approve it automatically.

statement: The system shall disburse the loan within 2 business days.
source_excerpt: Money should go out within 2 days.

statement: The system shall log every KYC decision with a timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: Log entry created for every decision.

statement: The system shall sync applicant data with the LOS before final approval.
acceptance_criteria: Sync completes before approval step runs.
source_excerpt: We need this to talk to the LOS.

statement: The system shall achieve 100% accuracy in fraud detection within 2 seconds.
source_excerpt: We want zero fraud getting through.

statement: The system shall handle exceptions in a timely manner.
The system shall require step-up authentication for a registered-contact change.
acceptance_criteria: Second factor required before the change is saved.
source_excerpt: Changing your phone number should need a second factor.

statement: The system shall retain completed loan records for at least 7 years.
acceptance_criteria: Records are queryable by loan ID for 7 years post-closure.
source_excerpt: We keep records for at least seven years.

statement: The system shall reject applications efficiently and provide reasonable feedback.
source_excerpt: Rejections should be quick and make sense.
